interpretation.adjusted_p_status: computed at family closure (DR-2); not available at freeze
interpretation.basis: Raw p = 0.5514 > 0.05 (raw, not family-adjusted). A Holm-adjusted p is never below its raw p, so the adjusted p at family closure also exceeds 0.05 and the registered outcome is inconclusive; the adjusted value itself is reported at closure.

branch_B.scope: A labelled diagnostic, not a finding of absence or equivalence (H1 section 10).

interpretation.decision_rule: DR-E4: reject when the Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 at family closure (section 10); no rejection is declared from the raw p alone
interpretation.limit: E4 measures the revision sensitivity of the H1 statistic in the first vintage that contains the quarter before onset; it is not a test of warning available before the onset quarter began, and the onset dates come from final data (prereg/E4.md sections 2 and 11; SD-07).
interpretation.nonpositive_note: The observed mean change S is nonpositive; an upper-tail comparison does not show an absolute positive rise in persistence.
interpretation.reference: fixed-date AR(2) surrogates fitted to each episode's first vintage containing the quarter before onset

statements.inconclusive: The E4 comparison did not detect an unusually large real-time pre-onset change relative to fixed-date AR(2) surrogates fitted to each episode's first vintage containing the quarter before onset. This concerns the revision sensitivity of the H1 statistic, not warning available before the onset quarter began.
statements.reject: The observed mean real-time pre-onset change was unusually large relative to fixed-date AR(2) surrogates fitted to each episode's first vintage containing the quarter before onset. This concerns the revision sensitivity of the H1 statistic, not warning available before the onset quarter began.

real_time_against_final.note: No test is attached. Same sign counts episodes where both changes are positive or both negative.

two_clocks.note: Description, not a test and not a claim of real-time warning (SD-07).
